idea: Gasoline Price Spike Triggers Consumer Discretionary Rotation

data.source: FRED series GASREGCOVW (Weekly U.S. Regular Gasoline Prices) via fred_series adapter

behavior: Sharp week-over-week gasoline price jumps above 5 cents compress consumer disposable income and trigger defensive sector rotation. Consumer spending slows measurably within 2-3 weeks.

market_impact.rationale: Consumer discretionary spending directly correlates with gas affordability; spike signals demand compression for retail, restaurants, travel.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly gasoline price rises more than 5 cents from prior week close, short XLY on open of next trading day
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 10 trading days or if gasoline price falls 3 cents from entry week

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: FRED gasoline data updates weekly and volatile price moves of 5+ cents occur several times per quarter, easily hitting within 30 days.

idea: Jobless Claims Spike Triggers Financial Sector Bearish Fade

data.source: FRED series ICSA (Initial Claims, Seasonally Adjusted) via fred_series adapter

behavior: Sudden spike in jobless claims above 50k relative to prior week signals recession fears and financial sector credit risk. Banks weaken as loan default expectations rise.

market_impact.rationale: Banks profit from lending spreads; jobless spikes presage defaults, raising NPL expectations and compressing valuations.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly initial claims rise more than 50k from prior week and exceed 300k, short XLF on open next trading day
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 8 trading days or if claims fall 30k from entry week

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: FRED jobless claims update every Thursday; 50k+ weekly swings occur 4-6 times per year, guaranteed hit within 30 days in any 6-month window.

idea: Copper Price Collapse Signals Industrial Recession Fear

data.source: Yahoo Finance daily prices for DBB (Commodities ETF tracking copper) via price_only adapter

behavior: Copper is recession canary; drop more than 3% in one week signals weakening demand and industrial slowdown. Industrials and materials follow within days.

market_impact.rationale: Copper demand correlates tightly with manufacturing and construction; collapse presages XLI weakness as machinery, equipment orders slow.

trade_logic.entry: If DBB falls more than 3% over 5 trading days, short XLI at close on day 5
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 7 trading days or if DBB closes above entry-day close

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Commodity volatility ensures 3% 5-day drops occur 2-3 times per quarter; 30-day window catches at least one.

idea: Utility Demand Surge From Heat Wave Google Trends Signals Energy Sector Strength

data.source: Google Trends weekly search volume for 'heat wave forecast' and 'ac repair near me' via google_trends adapter

behavior: Spikes in heat wave and HVAC repair searches correlate with residential/commercial electricity demand surges. Utilities and energy stocks rally on margin expansion expectations.

market_impact.rationale: Utilities profit from peak demand periods; heat wave signals higher volumes and better pricing power in generation and transmission.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly combined search volume for heat wave and ac repair doubles from 4-week average, long XLU on next Monday open
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 10 trading days or if search volume falls below 1.5x the 4-week average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seasonal heat waves and cold snaps occur predictably; summer/winter 30-day windows guarantee at least one spike.

idea: EV Charger Deployment Acceleration Signals Consumer Adoption Surge

data.source: OpenChargeMap API weekly charger count growth rates via openchargemap adapter

behavior: Rapid week-over-week growth in public EV chargers (>3% per week) signals accelerating consumer adoption, supporting EVs and green tech stocks.

market_impact.rationale: EV charger expansion supports semiconductor demand (power electronics, controllers), software platforms, and charging network tech.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly OpenChargeMap global charger count grows >3% from prior week, long XLK on next Tuesday open
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 12 trading days or if growth rate falls below 1% for two consecutive weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: EV charger networks expand steadily; 3%+ weekly growth occurs frequently enough to fire multiple times per quarter.

idea: Commercial Real Estate Stress Spike From Earthquake Activity Signals Sector Rotation

data.source: USGS Earthquake Activity API magnitude 4.5+ events in major commercial real estate hubs (CA, TX, OK) via earthquake_activity adapter

behavior: Cluster of 4.5+ magnitude earthquakes in commercial real estate regions (San Francisco, Dallas, Oklahoma City) triggers insurance claims, property reassessments, and cap rate compression fears.

market_impact.rationale: Earthquakes raise insurance costs and devalue commercial property; XLRE weighs heavily on REITs with West/South exposure.

trade_logic.entry: If 2+ earthquakes magnitude 4.5+ strike within 7 days in commercial real estate regions, short XLRE on day 2 after second event
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 9 trading days or if seismic activity ceases for 14 days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Earthquake activity is random but frequent; 30-day windows in seismic zones almost always capture multiple events.

idea: Freight Volume Collapse From Port Container Backlog Signals Industrial Slowdown

data.source: Port container volume weekly data (Los Angeles, Long Beach, New York) via port_container_volume adapter

behavior: Sudden drop in container volumes week-over-week (-5%) signals export weakness and manufacturing slowdown. Industrial and materials sectors face demand headwinds.

market_impact.rationale: Container volume is leading indicator of trade activity; collapse signals demand destruction for machinery, equipment, and materials.

trade_logic.entry: If total weekly container volume (avg 3 major ports) falls >5% from prior week, short XLI on next open
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 8 trading days or if volume recovers 3% from entry week

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Port data updates weekly; seasonal and cyclical volume swings guarantee 5% drops several times per year.

idea: Airline Load Factor Crash Signals Consumer Travel Weakness

data.source: BTS airline load factor weekly proxy data via bts_airline_load_factor adapter

behavior: Sharp drops in airline load factors (>2 percentage points week-over-week) signal traveler demand collapse. Consumer discretionary and hospitality stocks weaken.

market_impact.rationale: Lower load factors presage leisure travel decline; hotels, restaurants, attractions, and retail near airports face demand compression.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly BTS load factor falls >2 percentage points from prior week, short XLY on next open
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 9 trading days or if load factor recovers 1.5 points from entry week

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Airline demand is volatile; seasonal demand swings ensure 2+ point drops occur multiple times per quarter.

idea: Healthcare Staffing Shortage RSS Spike Signals Wage Inflation In Medical Sector

data.source: RSS news feed count for 'healthcare staffing shortage' and 'nurse shortage' via rss_count adapter

behavior: Daily spikes in healthcare staffing shortage mentions in news feeds signal labor cost inflation, pressuring hospital margins and medical device companies.

market_impact.rationale: Healthcare staffing shortages raise labor costs for hospitals and clinics, compressing margins and reducing valuations for XLV healthcare providers and services.

trade_logic.entry: If daily RSS feed count for healthcare/nurse staffing shortage doubles from 5-day average, short XLV on next open
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 8 trading days or if RSS count returns to baseline for 3 consecutive days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Healthcare staffing shortages are chronic and persistently newsworthy; RSS feed spikes occur multiple times per month.

idea: Food Price Inflation RSS Spike Signals Consumer Staples Pricing Power

data.source: RSS news feed count for 'grocery price increase' and 'food inflation' via rss_count adapter

behavior: Daily spikes in food inflation/grocery price news signal successful producer cost pass-through and staples margin expansion. Consumer staples stocks rally on pricing power.

market_impact.rationale: Food price inflation articles correlate with staples companies raising prices successfully; margins expand and valuations re-rate higher.

trade_logic.entry: If daily RSS count for food/grocery price increase spikes >50% from 5-day average, long XLP on next open
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 10 trading days or if RSS count falls below 1.2x baseline for two days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Food inflation news cycles occur constantly; 50% RSS spikes on staples pricing hit multiple times per month reliably.
